text:
July 21, 1967

Today I had two dental implants placed at Garden Dente Clinic in Don Mueang.

The clinic is clean and has a backyard garden atmosphere. There's parking for about 4-5 cars. All the staff are lovely and friendly, answering all questions with clear explanations. Dr. Natee is kind, attentive, and very gentle. The anesthetic injection was painless. He constantly asked if I was in pain or felt any tightness or heaviness, and told me to let him know if I felt any discomfort so he could add more anesthetic. In the end, I didn't need any additional anesthetic injections. I was very impressed with everything.

Each implant cost 21,990 baht, brand BIOTEM from Korea, with bone grafting costing 4,500 baht per sachet. #I can honestly say this clinic has the best price. In 5 months, I'll have the crowns placed. Then I'll have a right molar to chew food with! 😁

text:
Although the clinic is new, the owner is knowledgeable, friendly, provides complete information, and doesn't pressure you into rushing into a deal.

The doctor is a professor with extensive experience, has a gentle touch, and provides advice and treatment based on your symptoms. He plans the treatment carefully (patients must cooperate).

Affordable prices. Appointments are required (don't miss appointments or your work schedule will be damaged).

3-car parking space. No overlapping appointments. There's a waiting room.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมการ์เด้น เดนเต้ Garden Dente Clinic
text: The doctor is very kind, and Nong Por is very cute. They gave great advice, and Nong Por's family is also lovely. We highly recommend them. If you have dental problems, you can come see the doctor. They give excellent advice. The doctor is very reasonable about the price. I was one of those who worried about the cost, but after meeting Dr. Natee, Nong Por, and their family, I felt much more at ease. 😍🥰
